_doc: #783 THE ONE DECLARATION of every place a fleet app keeps state, read by (1) libs:core FleetConfig — the export/import contract every fleet app serves through its <package>.fleetconfig provider, which exports/imports exactly the migrating stores declared here and nothing else; #796 this file lives in the SuperApp only (it is fleet-wide data: baked into libs:core it rebuilt all 33 apps on every edit) and TRAVELS WITH EVERY CALL -- FleetConfig.export/import put it in the call extras, each app's provider applies what it is handed; (2) the SuperApp Account (Runtime reads it, Drift diffs it, server→runtime and the new-phone migration apply it); (3) cloud-vault Shared/configs/emit.py (the `settings` section carries one entry per app below); (4) fleet-config-guard.yml, which fails when the code opens a store this file does not declare. Edit here, never a copy.

classes.config: user-facing setting that defines "my configuration": migrates to a new phone (exported, diffed, applied).
classes.secret: a credential: migrates through the vault, always masked on screen (exported only to fleet-signed callers).
classes.device: never migrates: install ids, device keys, caches, cursors, trackers, sync state, migration markers.
classes.content: user data that lives on a server or in the shared store: only the account link migrates, never the bytes.

kinds.prefs: SharedPreferences — exported and imported by the contract with no app code.
kinds.encrypted: EncryptedSharedPreferences (default MasterKey, AES256_SIV keys / AES256_GCM values) — exported and imported by the contract through the same cipher.
kinds.datastore: Preferences DataStore — declared and counted; the contract cannot write it under the app's live in-memory copy, so it is reported as not yet covered.
kinds.room: Room database — declared and counted; config inside a database is reported as not yet covered.
kinds.file: a file the app keeps (dotfiles, json, models) — declared per app/lib under `items`.

<default>.doc: The app's default SharedPreferences (<package>_preferences): HeliBoard keyboard settings (libs:keyboard), translate settings (libs:translate), the vault's bwPreferencesStorage keys, and the terminals' settings (Termux TermuxAppSharedPreferences: fontsize, log_level, extra keys, soft keyboard, screen-on; the session cursor, notification id and per-boot counters are device). Element X keeps only DI scaffolding here (device). bg_startup_tracing is the WebView's own startup-tracing flag, written into any app that hosts a WebView (device). Device for apps whose current code reads none of it: mail (the FairEmail-era settings the Sterna clone, 8b7ca107d, never reads — migrating them would only plant dead keys), notes (an intro-shown marker only) and office (the asset-extraction commit marker only).

AppCenter.doc: Legacy Xamarin AppCenter prefs read once by LegacyAppCenterMigrator to carry old Bitwarden settings forward; migration source only.

autofill_sot.doc: The non-secret autofill Source of Truth Cloud Account owns (a0_docs/eng-specs/autofill-3-tier.md): profiles_json (names, emails, phones, postal addresses), rules_json (per-site form mapping rules), snippets_json (keyboard snippets), next_id. Served to Cloud Browser and Cloud Keyboard by AutofillSotProvider behind AUTOFILL_PROFILE_READ/WRITE. Never a password, code or card: there is no column for one.

autocomplete_store.doc: #1103 Cloud Keyboard's own Autocomplete database (IDs, Addresses, URLs, Secrets), kept like a browser's autofill store: one key, rows, holding an AES-GCM blob sealed with a non-exportable Android Keystore key of this phone. It is a cache of what Cloud Account syncs to the keyboard over its accountdata provider (grant autocomplete.read): it is re-filled from there, cannot be read on another phone (the key stays here) and never migrates. No vault calls, no network.

PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS.doc: Mattermost per-notification-group JSON used to dedupe/clear delivered notifications; transient.

VERSION_PREFERENCE.doc: Mattermost app-version marker that resets the notification cache on upgrade.

account_activity.doc: #1081 Cloud Account's Activity page: a short on-device log (newest last, capped at 200) of what the account did, as sentences naming a thing (revealed github.token, auto-backup ok). It never holds a secret value (ActivityFeed.record drops one that looks like it) and records this phone's history, never configuration.

account_data_migration.doc: #867 whether this app has already copied the imported configs, profile and S/R/L account files over from the Cloud Account app. It records this phone's progress, never configuration.

account_migrate.doc: #783 the new-phone migration journal: per app, the hash of the declared copy applied and its outcome, so a re-run resumes. It describes this phone's progress, never configuration.

acode_auth_secure.doc: Acode account auth token/session held in EncryptedSharedPreferences (Authenticator.PREFS_FILENAME).

acode_sftp_profiles_v1.doc: Acode saved SFTP connection profiles (host/user/credentials) via SftpSecurityStore; credential-bearing so secret.

acode_theme.doc: Acode editor colour scheme (key per theme colour) written by System.java so the crash/launch screens match the chosen theme; a user theme choice.

adb_shell.doc: Per-install random token shared with the local adb shell server (install identity), the flag that this install was ever paired with Wireless Debugging (drives the Cloud Store channel control: not paired vs down), and channel_mode, the owner's Privileged channel choice (local | embedded | shizuku | auto; default local where the app owns a local server).

ads.doc: Acode RewardPassManager ad-reward pass state; per-install ad counters, not configuration.

advisory_feed.doc: Single 'last' poll timestamp throttling the ntfy advisory feed; sync cursor.

agent-auth.doc: #790 the agent CLIs' credentials in each terminal, keyed by the environment variable each CLI reads (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN for claude, OPENROUTER_API_KEY for goose and hermes). Configs ▸ Account imports it from the declared profile (settings › termux|nix-on-droid › agent-auth, derived from ai › tokens by the cockpit's agent_auth map); AgentAuth.java writes it on every start to $HOME/<ab_cloud-terminal-store/store.json::agent_auth.env_file> (0600), which login-init.sh sources into every session.

apps_mesh.doc: #793 the Apps Mesh page's chosen chip filter (`filter`): which members the page shows first. A view preference, so it moves with the phone; the probe cache itself is a cacheDir file and never migrates.

app_tabs.doc: User-arranged launcher app-tab entries (JSON list under 'entries').

auto_update.doc: Auto-update toggles (enabled, require_silent/unmetered) are settings; last_check/remote digest/bytes/unattended_pass are state.

pass_ledger.doc: #894 What the running fleet pass did per package (installed, needs a tap, failed), the summary signature last shown and the last failure reported per package: pass state, never a setting.

badge_customization.doc: Per-badge notification toggles (enabled/persistent/options) the user set in the notification center.

battery_history.doc: The old ledger of completed battery sessions/days. Read once by the battery SoT (libs:battery BatteryRepository) to seed battery_sot.db, then cleared; hardware-specific telemetry.

battery_session.doc: Plug/unplug anchors and charge counters of this battery. In the SuperApp the battery SoT (libs:battery BatteryRepository) imports the unplug anchor and the counted-cycle counters into battery_sot.db once and clears it; Cloud Nav still keeps its own.

browser_autofill.doc: #802 the browser's autofill profile: identity + addresses + card METADATA (label, holder, last4, expiry, type) — never a card number or security code. vault_profile/vault_addresses are the vault bundle's about.profile/about.addresses (cockpit derived_settings, applied by server → runtime); profile is what was imported on the phone.

browser_ac_profiles.doc: #900 Autocomplete: the personal profiles (many-valued names, addresses, phones, emails, ID documents, birth dates, organisations), the per-site memory (values typed on one site: customer number, member ID) and the never-save lists. EncryptedSharedPreferences, MasterKey AES256_GCM. Imports the old browser_autofill profile once; never deletes it.

browser_ac_secrets.doc: #900 Autocomplete: saved sign-ins and cards. EncryptedSharedPreferences over which every password, card number and code is sealed again (AES-256-GCM, Android Keystore key cloud_browser_ac_v1, record-bound AAD), so it never migrates in the clear: the Keystore key does not leave the phone, and Cloud Vault is the fleet's migration path for secrets.

browser_bookmarks.doc: #802 the browser's bookmarks with their folders (bookmarks_json: url, title, folder path, ts).

browser_downloads.doc: #802 index of the downloads the browser started (DownloadManager ids and file names on THIS phone); the files themselves stay in Downloads.

browser_history.doc: Browsing history entries the user accumulated.

browser_settings.doc: #802 the browser's settings catalogue (ac_cloud-browser/build.json::ui.browser.settings): search engine, homepage, desktop site, text size, JavaScript, images, third-party cookies; one typed key per declared setting. Served by /api/browser/settings.

browser_site_permissions.doc: #802 per-site decisions host|permission -> allow/deny/ask (location, camera, microphone, and the javascript/images/trackers shields); a rule covers subdomains. #900 also host|zoom -> the site's text zoom in percent.

cal_agents.doc: Cloud Tasks agents: the screenshot agent's on/off switch, last scan time, dismissed candidate keys and the events the user accepted from screenshots; user decisions, not config.

cal_bridge.doc: Cloud Tasks one-time 'seeded' flag for legacy todo import.

tasks_prefs.doc: Cloud Tasks Settings > Appearance (light / dark / system) and where the user was: the top filter bar's status and tag selection and the list the Tasks page shows. The theme is the setting that moves to a new phone; the filter and the list id name rows of this phone's tasks database and mean nothing elsewhere.

tasks_ai.doc: Cloud Tasks AI panel (libs:ai): the model, Web switch and gateway agent last picked. The chat history itself is the sessions file ai-sessions.json under the app's files dir.

cal_legacy_todos.doc: Cloud Tasks legacy local todos JSON that is read once and seeded into the calendar engine; user data, not config.

caldav_secure_prefs.doc: Cloud Tasks EncryptedSharedPreferences holding CalDAV url/username/password; mostly credentials (url+username are the account link, migrate via vault with the password).

calendar_cache.doc: Cached CalDAV events, etags and last-sync times; server holds the data.

camera_modes.doc: cloud-camera per-mode prefs named after CameraMode: per-mode camera settings (resolution, flash, EIS...).

charge_snapshots.doc: Local charge snapshots of this battery.

git_storage.doc: Cloud Drive Git page: which storage the one Git page runs on (Cloud-Store, Emulated or External Drive); a viewing preference the owner keeps on a new phone.

cloud-drive-pdf-reader.doc: PDF reader night-mode and paged-mode toggles are viewing preferences; per-document last page ('last:<source>') is device.

cloud-drive-prefs.doc: cloud-drive file sort, hidden, dual-pane, thumbnails, bookmarks and sync rule enables are settings; mirror.result.* and sync.test.* are last-run results.

cloud-shared-store-migration.doc: cloud-shared-store: whether this install already showed the one-time shared-uid notice (DataMigration). A fact about this install, never carried to a new phone.

cloud-drive-storage-grants.doc: SAF tree URI grant and name for this device's storage; persisted URI permissions do not exist on a new phone.

cloud_analytics.doc: Analytics consent is a user choice; visitor_id is a per-install identity.

cloud_code_chat_secrets.doc: Cloud Code Chat's OpenRouter token, pasted in Profile & Config: EncryptedSharedPreferences under a Keystore AES-256-GCM master key, shown masked, never handed to the WebView. A credential: migrates through the vault.

cloud_calc.doc: cloud-calc calculation history ('history' key, CalcState); user data, small and local.

cloud_calc_jev.doc: Jev decision config: config_override (the edited routing declaration), model_<use> picked models; catalog and catalog_at are a cached OpenRouter model list.

cloud_calc_jev_secret.doc: EncryptedSharedPreferences holding the manual OpenRouter token (openrouter_token).

cloud_camera.doc: cloud-calc level calibration (zero_tilt/pitch/roll/edge) measured against this phone's sensors; not valid on another device.

cloud_clock.doc: Clock engine data blob (alarms, timers, world-clock zones, stopwatch) as one JSON; alarms/timers/zones are user config; 'scheduled' is device alarm-scheduling state.

cloud_image_recognition.doc: Chosen image recognition route (on-device vs openrouter) and decision model.

cloud_sound_identification.doc: #798 the chosen sound identification route (on-device YAMNet vs a remote decision model), per app; the declaration's default_route until the user picks one.

cloud_nav_cockpit.doc: cloud-nav cockpit selected mode id ('mode'); a user layout choice.

cloud_search.doc: Cloud Search settings: dark theme, home city, chosen AI model, web-search toggle, and the saved listings (`saved`, a small JSON list kept only on this phone). #903 Things: the search radius (things_radius_km), the typed fallback city (things_city) and whether to use the coarse location (things_use_location) are configuration; whether the location permission was already asked (things_location_asked) is device state, as the permission itself is per phone. The last query per vertical (q:<vertical>) is device state.

cloud_sound.doc: cloud-calc sound meter calibration_db, a4_hz, temperature_c user-set parameters.

cloud_wake_lock.doc: #787 the terminal session wake lock: 'wanted' is the notification toggle (ON until the user turns it off; default build.json::wake_lock.default_on); battery_exemption_asked records that the one-time battery-optimization prompt was shown, so a new phone asks again.

cloud_webserver.doc: Local web server settings: enabled, port, doc_root, loopback_only, directory_listing.

commons.doc: cloud-camera shared settings (grid, flash, quality, timers, scan, geotag, sounds, aspect ratio); last captured item and storage URIs are device.

dagu_prefs.doc: Dagu server URL and user label are account links; bearer_token is a credential.

store_fleet_bearer.doc: #866 Cloud Store's own entry of the fleet bearer for the Commits / CI-CD feeds, used only when SuperApp (which holds the token and serves it over its CONSTELLATION_DATA provider) is not installed; a credential.

call_history.doc: Cloud Dialer: the system call log and blocked numbers, served by the handler the app registers. Carried in the device file so a new phone keeps its call history; restore adds the missing calls and blocked numbers (needs the default phone app role) and never deletes.

cloud_dialer_sms.doc: Cloud Dialer SMS: which conversation threads the owner pinned or archived, the SIM the owner prefers, and the SIM each thread last sent on (SmsPrefs). The owner's own choices, so a new phone keeps them.

c3_routes_table.doc: Cloud C3 > Containers > Table: the chosen sort column and direction, the Auth Type and VM filters, the category filter and the search text, as one string under the key 'state'.

contacts_vcards.doc: Cloud Contacts: every contact in the phone's system contacts (names, phones, emails, addresses, organisation, birthday, note; no photos) as vCard text, served by the handler the app registers. Carried in the device file so a new phone gets its contacts; restore adds the missing ones to a phone-local account and never deletes.

store_integrity_marks.doc: Cloud Store: packages declared integrity unknown that the user reported 'did not run' after a play-anon install, marked as needing Play Integrity on this phone. A finding about the apps, so it moves with the phone (also exported in the app inventory).

store_declared_edits.doc: Cloud Store: the user's edits to the Declared list over the built-in source map — apps declared from Search or Installed (with the rungs they install from) and declared apps removed. The user's app list, so it moves with the phone.

store_play_anon.doc: Cloud Store's cached anonymous Google Play session from the declared dispenser (auth token, gsfId, device tokens, fetch time), reused for token_ttl_minutes. Bound to this device registration and short-lived: never migrated, a new phone asks the dispenser again.

update_checks.doc: #1078 Cloud Store: whether the one-time battery-optimization prompt has been shown on this phone; a prompt marker, never migrated (the new phone asks once itself).

data_usage_history.doc: Per-app/sub data usage history measured on this device.

datastore:cloud-notes.doc: Cloud Notes generic key/value DataStore written by the web layer via a plugin (caches/state, no Kotlin-defined settings); not a curated config.

datastore:auth-sessions.doc: Cloud Notes per-server auth session cookies/tokens.

datastore:elementx_announcement.doc: Which in-app announcements were already shown.

datastore:elementx_crash.doc: Crash-report flag/text left for the next launch.

datastore:elementx_featureflag.doc: Developer feature-flag overrides chosen by the user (flag key -> bool).

datastore:elementx_preferences.doc: App-wide preferences: theme, developerMode, elementCallBaseUrl, media preview, log level, notification sound/ringtone.

datastore:elementx_rageshake.doc: Rageshake enabled flag and sensitivity - user setting.

datastore:elementx_voice_player.doc: Voice message playback speed - user preference.

datastore:full_screen_intent_permissions.doc: Tracker of whether the full-screen-intent permission banner was dismissed/asked.

datastore:location_<hash>.doc: Live location disclaimer-accepted flag and expiry timestamps.

datastore:pin_code_store.doc: App lock: encoded PIN, remaining attempts, biometric flag; PIN hash is a credential.

datastore:push_client_secret_store.doc: Per-session push client secrets generated on this install for the push gateway; regenerated on the new phone.

datastore:push_store.doc: Push counter and battery-optimization banner state.

datastore:push_store_<userId>.doc: Per-user notificationEnabled toggle (config); provider name, push key and registration-error flag are install-bound.

datastore:session_<hash>_preferences.doc: Per-account privacy/media prefs: presence, read receipts, typing, compress media, skip verification.

datastore:session_<hash>_seen-invites.doc: Invites already seen; notification dedupe state.

datastore:settings.doc: Mail (sterna) settings: theme, app_style (CLOUD_DARK default, GMAIL_DARK, CLOUD_EINK - the whole-app look), density, swipe actions, signature, PGP provider, notification content, quiet hours, image allowlist, RSS feeds. Same file name used by gallery.

datastore:vector_analytics.doc: Analytics opt-in consent choice (user_consent); analytics_id and did_ask_user_consent are device-local.

dev_control.doc: Dev-control server enable and port; token is a credential.

encrypted_datastore_flags.doc: Migration-done flag for the encrypted DataStore.

encrypted_db_prefs.doc: Keystore-wrapped DB passphrase and encryption/migration flags; bound to this device's Keystore, cannot be moved.

events_cache.doc: Cached GDELT/feed event lists per source (events_<id>) and their fetch times; refetched from the server.

events_saved.doc: Saved events the user bookmarked; also holds etag/last-sync cache keys.

firewall_policies.doc: Per-app firewall policies (wifi/cellular/background/vpn/direction) the user set.

fleet_alerts.doc: Local ring buffer (max 100) of received fleet alerts; derived inbox, regenerated by the fleet.

fleet_dns_prefs.doc: Chosen DNS preset and ordered fallbacks (DNS menu); also holds throwaway mesh-down tunnel keys and last lookup.

floating_nav_pos.doc: Floating button x/y screen coordinates, tied to this screen.

gallery_widget_prefs.doc: Per-appWidgetId widget media URI lists; widget ids and content URIs are tied to this install.

gh_feed_cache.doc: 15-minute TTL cache of GitHub commits/workflow-run feeds.

gitea_feed_cache.doc: 15-minute TTL cache of Gitea commit feed responses (GiteaFeed PREFS constant), pure cache.

health_store.doc: Health Connect snapshots, history and source last-seen; cache of device data.

health_user.doc: #1180 Cloud Me > Health user data, one JSON string under 'data': saved body measurements, lab results, ticked plan events and shopping items, the workout log, chosen activity level, sleep target and dossier choices. Your own entries, so they move with the phone; Health Connect readings are never copied in (the trackers read them live).

buro_user.doc: Cloud Me > Buro user data, one JSON string under 'data' (collections of typed records): personal due-diligence items, assets, services, liabilities and taxes, budget lines, accounts and cashflow entries. Your own entries, so they move with the phone; the reports (budget vs cashflow, accounts vs cashflow) are derived from them and never stored.

profile_health_user.doc: Cloud Me > Profile > Health record values, one JSON string under 'data' (field id to value, status, expiry), imported from the private store. Special-category data: it stays on the device and in the encrypted backup, never in a public repo; the schema (labels only) is the public asset.

repo_tree.doc: Cloud Me > Lnktree > Proj (#1298): which nodes of the repository tree are expanded, one string set under 'expanded' (registry node codes such as 1.2 or 1.2.1). A view preference of the owner: it migrates so the tree reopens as it was left.

profile_dd_user.doc: Cloud Me > Profile > DD (due diligence) dossier values, one JSON string under 'data' (field id to value, status, expiry), imported from the private store. Special-category data: it stays on the device and in the encrypted backup, never in a public repo; the schema (labels only) is the public asset.

experiences_user.doc: Cloud Me > Achieves > Experiences user data, one JSON string under 'data': your own done and to-do experiences (accepted suggestions, edits, additions). Moves with the phone and the backup.

inventory_user.doc: #1367 Cloud Me > Inventory user data, one JSON string under 'data' (collections of typed item records per sub-page: housing, household, transport, parking, utilities, taxes, insurance, contracts, banking, subscriptions, leisure, food, care, clothing, electronics, education) plus the `_seeded` marker of the collections whose declared mock seed was already applied once. Your own entries, so they move with the phone and the backup; the summary (count, value, monthly recurring) is derived and never stored.

llc_user.doc: Cloud Me > LLC user data (the former Work section), one JSON string under 'data' (collections of typed records): employment contracts, side-hustle income, company assets and portfolio holdings. Your own entries, so they move with the phone; gain, allocation and income totals are derived and never stored.

home_swipe_prefs.doc: User's chosen action for swipe up/left/right/down on the launcher home.

ide_prefs.doc: cloud-myterminal IdePrefs: terminal_backend choice, per-backend ssh host/user (terminal_<backend>_host/_user), dev_api_enabled, the #787 wake_lock_wanted toggle and the pinch-zoom terminal_font_size (px, 6..32; the frontend reads it through the AndroidTerm bridge and migrates its old localStorage myk-term-font-size into it, so "apply all" carries the size to a new phone); all user choices, except battery_exemption_asked, which records that the one-time battery-optimization prompt was shown.

idle_tunnel.doc: Idle WireGuard tunnel name and full config text (contains the private key).

import_configs.doc: EncryptedSharedPreferences, THE Account vault's one keystore-backed file (#874): `configs_json` the Connections (the imported blob incl. auth.authelia_token and email, fleet bearer, mesh, DNS, Dagu, mail), `data_json` the identities, `app_configs_json` the Configs captured from every app; `grants_json` the per-app Secret grants (never migrates: a grant is the owner's decision on THIS phone) and `grants_seeded` its marker. Mostly credentials. `mail_signatures` is the copy of Mail's signatures the vault last held for the bundle (Mail's own store is the source of truth and travels through mail_signatures).

kdeconnect_clipboard.doc: Clipboard history exchanged with the peer.

kdeconnect_device_overrides.doc: Per-device host/port/label overrides for paired KDE Connect peers.

kdeconnect_identity.doc: This install's KDE Connect device_id; identity.

kdeconnect_peer_selection.doc: Which KDE peer Peer Control targets.

kdeconnect_trust.doc: Pinned peer certificates and paired flags; tied to this device's keystore, must re-pair on a new phone.

launcher_settings.doc: Launcher settings: screensaver, scale, brightness, eye intensity, screensaver timeout, animation/one-hand/control toggles, and the icons-per-row steppers grid_cols_cloud and grid_cols_phone (4..8; absent until the owner moves a stepper, so a phone that never chose follows the shipped default and a chosen value migrates with the phone).

web_bluetooth_grants.doc: #1222 Cloud Browser's Web Bluetooth permission memory: per site origin, the Bluetooth devices (address, name) the user picked in the chooser and the services the page named. Device addresses belong to this phone's radio and pairings, so it never migrates; a private tab keeps its grants in memory only.

web_serial_grants.doc: #1225 Cloud Browser's Web Serial permission memory: per site origin, the USB serial ports (vendor:product key, name) the user picked in the chooser. A port is a cable on this phone, so it never migrates; a private tab keeps its grants in memory only.

web_usb_grants.doc: #1225 Cloud Browser's WebUSB permission memory: per site origin, the USB devices (vendor:product key, name) the user picked in the chooser. Devices are plugged into this phone, so it never migrates; a private tab keeps its grants in memory only; Android's own per-device USB permission is separate and asked again after a replug.

web_nfc_grants.doc: #1225 Cloud Browser's Web NFC permission memory: per site origin, whether the user allowed the site to read and write NFC tags. The NFC radio belongs to this phone, so it never migrates; a private tab keeps its grant in memory only.

nfc_history.doc: #1264 libs:nfc's scan history: one JSON array (key entries, at most 500 rows) of tag scans - time, UID, type, technologies, the NDEF summary, a note. Never a Wi-Fi key or any tag secret. The user's own data, exported as JSON / CSV from Measure > NFC > History. Kept by libs:nfc, so every app that compiles it (Cloud Calc) carries it.

light_prefs.doc: #1155 the Light tool's settings: default light (rear/front/both), mode (spotlight/flashing) and strobe rate (capped at 3 Hz), rear and front intensity, timer on/duration, keep-on. Preferences of the user, so they move with the phone. Kept by libs:light, so every app that compiles it (the SuperApp, Cloud Calc's Toolkit > Light) carries it.

gateway_auth.doc: Cloud Mail (ac_cloud-mail) per-account edge-gate sign-in: one Keystore AES-256-GCM sealed JSON blob per account id (key gw_<id>) holding the Authelia flag and the captured authelia_session cookie. A credential: sealed, never logged, replayed only to the account's own domain. (#1090) The same file also holds one sealed blob per fleet account under key ep_<id>: the mesh URL and public URL Cloud Account published for it, the owner's endpoint policy (mesh_first / mesh_only / public_only) and the synced fleet bearer. The bearer is a credential: sealed, shown masked, sent only to the exact public host, never to the mesh host.

mail_auth_prefs.doc: Cloud Mail's per-account gateway credentials (Authelia in front of the JMAP server): one encrypted JSON blob per account, key auth:<email>, holding the auth mode (none / bearer / authelia), the pasted bearer token and the captured authelia_session cookie. Credentials: shown masked, never logged, replayed only to the account's own domain.

mail_jmap_prefs.doc: JMAP server and email are account links; password is a credential.

maps_basemap_prefs.doc: Basemap family, style key and 3D toggle.

timeline_state.doc: Timeline store migration marker (#1114): when the stops, step samples and raw fixes were moved into the one timeline store (maps.db timeline_segments); the store itself is re-derived on the new phone, never migrated.

tracker_engine.doc: Tracking engine settings (sources, accurate-fix / cell / motion triggers), its progress counters and the learned step length.

tracker_corrections.doc: The owner's corrections to the Tracker timeline (confirmed visits, edited places and modes, deleted or split segments, added visits). Recorded data tied to the timeline store, never migrated; the store is re-derived on the new phone.

tracker_home.doc: The owner's home-city override for the Trips tab (blank = detect from the most frequent sleep city of the last 90 days). Tied to the timeline store, re-derivable, never migrated.

tracker_place_addr_v2.doc: Cache of reverse-geocoded addresses and POI name + category (open provider answers by ~11 m grid cell) so a place is asked once; re-fetched on demand.

maps_tracker_state.doc: Live tracker runtime state (last position, buffers, decision).

maps_tracking.doc: Tracking thresholds and intervals the user tuned.

markets_last_good.doc: Last good Yahoo price per symbol (price|asOf|savedAt) for the Markets badge, so a killed process still shows the last rate; refetched on the next poll.

mattermost_prefs.doc: Mattermost server_url/user_id are account links; token is a credential.

mode_prefs.doc: Admin/apps mode toggle of the shell.

mount-keeper.doc: Ids of the mounts the sticky foreground MountKeeperService keeps alive on this phone; live FUSE mounts are per-device, so the set is rebuilt on the new phone.

mounts-credentials.doc: Encrypted mount passwords and key passphrases keyed by mount id.

news_bridge.doc: News one-time 'seeded' flag for legacy saved-articles import.

news_cache.doc: Cached articles, timelines and fetch times per channel; refetched from the server.

news_channel.doc: Active channel per news source (the one the user picked). Device in Cloud News: since the engine split (9aa7c735a) the app no longer links libs:news, so a copy of this file in com.diegonmarcos.cloudnews is a pre-split leftover no code reads; the live choice is held by the Cloud-Lib-News engine in its own package.

news_config.doc: News backend base URL and its two refresh integers (the user can point it at the mesh or the public gateway).

bundle._doc: #873/#874 THE BUNDLE ROUTES: where each Connections value of Cloud Account's vault (the imported configs blob, `section.key` paths) lands in the fleet, as declared stores. Fleet Setup (libs:account SetupPlan) finds every app that declares the store (used_by its module or one of its libs) and applies the key through that app's `<package>.fleetsetup` provider. A target with `pull` names the app Cloud Account reads the value FROM, once, when its vault holds none (AccountMigrate: the stores SuperApp kept). A value the declared copy's `settings` subtree or the Configs section names itself (app > store > file > key) needs no route. Edit here, never a copy in code; fleet-setup-guard checks every route names a declared store, a key it may migrate and a pull app that declares the store.

_doc_items: apps[].items / libs[].items: configuration kept OUTSIDE a declared store (files, a fork's own database). `store` names the declared store that actually holds it (the contract moves it when that store is portable); `via: install` = reproduced by installing the same build (baked from git); `via: connect` = re-fetched from the vault on Connect. Anything else with a migrating class is a named gap in the coverage.
